title: Ship merges when the repository refuses auto-merge
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115i npm bug row: drain exit 74 with `GraphQL: Auto merge is not allowed for this repository` (.krn/runs/clause-proof/npm-1115i.log ~498) although the npm plain row merged on krn-works/outside-npm in the same run; the hidden grade then failed (held-back test 9, matrix parameters `;foo=bar;baz`).
Outcome: ship either merges directly when the repository refuses auto-merge and the required checks are green (or no required check exists), or the row/doctor makes the repository allow auto-merge before draining; the exit says which. Find why the same repo allowed auto-merge for one row and not the other (does the row recreate/re-push the repo with default settings?).
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, src/deliver/transport.ts, scripts/outside-acceptance.ts, tests.
Proof: regression test on the verbatim GraphQL refusal red before the fix; outside npm bug rerun merges.
